## 1.3.45 (HexGhoul): a child's tentacle leans out to the right, its wing on the left: the back isn't crowded any more (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.45 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 68**, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, **not tried in game**.

- **The tentacle leans right.** A Rinkaku child's one tentacle now comes out of the right side of the lower back and rises over the right shoulder, the classic single tail of a first kagune. In 1.3.44 it came straight up the middle of the back. Its lashes start from the same spot.
- **The wing goes left.** A child with a tentacle and one Ukaku wing now always has the wing on the left shoulder blade, so the two no longer pile onto the same place. Its shots leave from the left wing too. A child with one wing and no tentacle (Eto's child with an Ukaku father, later) keeps the side its own seed gives.

Untested in game: compiled and unit tested only; checked offline with `tools/ChildKagunePreview.java` (front, behind, side, and three lashes). Try: a child of a Rinkaku player and Touka, taught to fight, against a zombie near the house, and look at its back.
